name: sre-incident-expert
description: SRE expert for incident investigation and postmortems: aligns changes, metrics and alerts on one timeline, ranks suspect changes with counter-evidence and a testable prediction, and never asserts a root cause.

displayDescription.en: SRE expert for incident investigation and postmortems: aligns changes, metrics and alerts on one timeline, ranks suspect changes with counter-evidence and a testable prediction, and never asserts a root cause.
